notes: Dungeon room situations (Plan 6, Track D): site situations with room: true, played only in a delve of the dungeons in dungeons.json and never on the road or at an ordinary site. Write DCs at standard difficulty (10-15); the engine rebases them to the dungeon's CR. PLACEHOLDER: the placeholder-crypt-* situations only exercise validation. Replace them with the real dungeons' rooms (Plan 6 D5).

start.text: The stair drops into the dark, and three of its steps have fallen into a black gap.

fail.text: {actor} lands short and drags themselves up, bruised.

partial.text: {actor} makes it with a scraped shin.

success.text: {actor} clears the gap and steadies the others across.

options.label: Climb down the side slowly
options.description: Safe, but it wears you out.

outcome.text: You inch down the rough wall, hand over hand, and arrive tired.

start.text: The skulls on the shelves twitch. A tide of grave rats pours out of the eye sockets.

fail.text: The rats swarm {actor} before they scatter.

success.text: {actor} breaks the swarm, and the rest flee into the walls.

options.label: Wave fire at them
options.description: Rats fear flame; a poor wave just makes them angry.

fail.text: The torch gutters, and the rats come on.

partial.text: The rats back off, hissing, and let you pass.

success.text: {actor} sweeps the flame low, and the swarm breaks and runs.

start.text: Someone has arranged the bones on the floor into an arrow pointing deeper in.

fail.text: {actor} studies it too long; the cold gets into everyone.

partial.text: {actor} guesses an earlier delver left it. Maybe.

success.text: {actor} sees it was laid as a warning, and which way to come at the tomb.

options.label: Step over it and go on

outcome.text: You step over the arrow and go on.

start.text: The lid grinds aside. The crypt's founder sits up, dust spilling from its ribs.

fail.text: Its cold hands find {actor}'s throat before it falls.

partial.text: It takes a long, ugly fight to lay it back down.

success.text: {actor} strikes it apart, and the bones are still.

options.label: Speak the burial rites
options.description: A good prayer lays it to rest; a bad one wastes the moment.

fail.text: The words mean nothing to it, and it lunges.

partial.text: It hesitates, then sinks back slowly, clawing.

success.text: {actor} speaks the old words, and the founder lies down again.
